answer: To make Sybil identities costly, require each new participant to lock a refundable 15-POA bond for 30 days and expose a random 1-in-20 sample of work to independent review; proven duplicate identities lose the bond after appeal. A farm of 100 accounts must tie up 1,500 POA for a month and risks losing it, making large-scale participation costly even before computing or coordination. Keep the rule public and provide a way to contest false matches. Challenge markers: oasis atlas tide
